Bill.BriefDescription: Notifying tribes of significant natural resource-related action by certain state entities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing notification of natural resourcerelated actions; adding a new section to chapter 43.17 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 43.30 RCW; adding a new section to chapter43.300 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 43.23 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 43.21A RCW; adding a new section to chapter 47.01RCW; adding a new section to chapter 43.20 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 43.70 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 76.09 RCW; andadding a new section to chapter 89.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notification of any significant natural resourcerelated actionundertaken by any state entity listed in subsection (2) of this sectionmust be provided to the legislative authority of any federallyrecognized Indian tribe that is, or could be, affected by the action. (2) This section applies only to the following state entities: (a) The board of natural resources and the department of naturalresources; (b) The forest practices board; p. 1 HB 2497 (c) The department of fish and wildlife and the fish and wildlifecommission; (d) The department of agriculture; (e) The department of ecology; (f) The state conservation commission; (g) The department of transportation; and (h) The state board of health and the department of health. (3) As used in this section, the term "natural resourcerelatedaction" includes any agency rule, policy statement, order,administrative decision, or execution of statutory functions thatsignificantly affects, or is related to, the state's water, mineral,forest, fisheries, or wildlife resources. (4)(a) The state entities listed in subsection (2) of this sectionmust individually, or collectively, adopt an administrative rule underchapter 34.05 RCW that details how this section is administered. Therule, or rules, must include at a minimum: (i) A mechanism for determining which federally recognized Indiantribes are affected by a particular agency action; (ii) A mechanism for determining which agency actions significantlyaffect, or relate to, a resource detailed in subsection (3) of thissection; and (iii) The manner in which the affected tribes will be notified. (b) In adopting rules under this section, the affected agencies areexpected to invite the involvement of the appropriate tribal interestsin order to determine, at a minimum, how notification may be providedin the most economical and time efficient manner, how the agenciesdetermine which actions are important enough to the tribes to justifynotification, and which actions will be viewed as unimportant oradministrative by the tribes. (5) Nothing in this section affects or replaces any othernotification requirement contained in state law.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any rule, policy statement, order, administrative decision, orexecution of statutory functions performed by the department or boardmust comply with the tribal notification requirements of section 1 ofthis act.

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any rule, policy statement, order, administrative decision, orexecution of statutory functions performed by the department orcommission must comply with the tribal notification requirements ofsection 1 of this act.
